# Global command wrapper corpus (#4566 r17)

These are generated bytes with one literal path `__TARGET__` (and Yarn 4's
`__RUNTIME__`) replacing the target. Tests read this corpus independently of
`clients/global-command-wrappers.ts`. No executable source is taken from a
project to populate the runtime registry.

| Files | Generator | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| npm-* | cmd-shim 6.0.3 | https://github.com/npm/cmd-shim/blob/6283211cbd16527bbd575f6d1ce12b92333d696b/lib/index.js |
| pnpm-* | @zkochan/cmd-shim 6.0.0 | https://github.com/pnpm/cmd-shim/blob/b9c389b161cb4370f5deda9ff78df03a7a6683c2/src/index.ts |
| classic-* | @zkochan/cmd-shim 3.1.0 | https://github.com/yarnpkg/yarn/blob/v1.22.22/package.json and src/package-linker.js |
| yarn4-* | @yarnpkg/cli 4.9.2 makePathWrapper | https://github.com/yarnpkg/berry/blob/%40yarnpkg/cli/4.9.2/packages/yarnpkg-core/sources/scriptUtils.ts |

Capture: invoke each published generator on `__TARGET__` beside `tool`, with
`#!/usr/bin/env node\n` for node/preserve, and an empty file for direct.
Set createCmdFile:true for pnpm/Classic; Classic 3.1.0 gitHead b3c57c06211afd3738ecdfd6fde94ea9d49b7de1;
Classic createPwshFile:false as Yarn
Classic does. Preserve adds preserveSymlinks:true. npm has no preserve option.
Yarn 4 uses the two verbatim makePathWrapper string expressions with argv0
`__RUNTIME__` and args `["__TARGET__"]`; its writer emits no PowerShell file.
The scratch generator dependencies were installed separately from the linked
workspace dependencies. Classic's mkdirp-promise needs mkdirp 0.5.6.

This is a bounded admission set, not a claim to support every generator option:
NODE_PATH/prependToPath, alternate interpreters, arbitrary shebang arguments,
and changes in other releases refuse until separately captured and tested.
Literal slots use a positive alphabet safe in all three template languages;
expansion syntax and quote/escape characters refuse, even when a filename
containing them could otherwise be valid. Trusted projects retain their opt-out.
